Pose - Looking Down.name: Pose - Looking Down
Pose - Looking Down.description:
🕴️ Pose: Looking Down
Angled downward, looking at something below — reflective, contemplative, or observing from a height.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Pose - Looking Down.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Within the selected Portrait Framing, lower the chin and direct the eyes downward while preserving the selected camera angle, camera distance, subject position, and crop. Do not place the character above the camera unless the selected frame explicitly requires a low-angle view. Female: the neck curves as the chin drops, shoulders soft. Male: the neck holds as the chin drops square. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own neck line.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
